items.criterion: The service assigns a strictly increasing per-document sequence and two clients appending at the same moment receive two different values.
items.judgment: Append four operations concurrently and compare the four returned sequences.

items.criterion: Two operations on one property of one node resolve to the higher sequence and the earlier one is recorded superseded.
items.judgment: Append two competing operations and read the log back for the surviving outcome.

items.criterion: An operation against a node an earlier operation deleted is recorded discarded and the response names the member who deleted it.
items.judgment: Delete a node in one session, edit it in another, and read the outcome and the attribution off the response.

items.criterion: Replaying an operation identifier the document already holds returns the original sequence and writes no second row.
items.judgment: Post one payload twice and compare the returned sequence and the operation row count.

items.criterion: A revision's content hash is the lowercase SHA-256 of the exact bytes stored at its pinned object key.
items.judgment: Materialise a revision and confirm the object exists in the bucket at the key the response names.

items.criterion: Restoring an earlier revision appends one revision carrying two parents and leaves every later revision reachable.
items.judgment: Restore the oldest revision and compare the revision set before and after.

items.criterion: A published build's bytes exist in the object store at the pinned revision key scheme.
items.judgment: Read the channel's current build and confirm the object is present in the bucket.

items.criterion: A document that has never been published is reachable from no unauthenticated runtime address.
items.judgment: Request the runtime address for the draft document's slug with no credential.

items.criterion: An unpublished document appears in no marketplace ordering and in no search result.
items.judgment: Read every ordering and one search term and look for the draft document's title.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes of one document to one channel leave the channel referring to exactly one build.
items.judgment: Fire two publishes at once and count the accepted responses and the channel's current build.

items.criterion: Accepting an invitation over the seat cap writes no member row and holds the invitation at seat_blocked.
items.judgment: Invite and accept an editor into a full workspace and read the member count and the invitation state.

items.criterion: A viewer session calling an editor-only endpoint is refused and the protected rows are unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the create endpoint from a viewer session and compare the document row count.

items.criterion: A viewer granted one folder reads the name of no folder off the granted path.
items.judgment: Read the folder collection as the seeded viewer and look for the two folders outside the grant.

items.criterion: The featured ordering places a lower-liked listing first when its editorial rank is higher.
items.judgment: Read the featured ordering and compare the position of the two seeded listings.

items.criterion: A cursor paging session over the marketplace repeats no listing.
items.judgment: Page to the end with the cursor header and look for a duplicate slug.

items.criterion: A fresh account reads an empty top-level array for its own documents rather than an error.
items.judgment: Sign up and read the document collection of the new workspace.
